title: Boardroom Governance Podcast: 'one of my biggest fears was how governance experts would react'
summary: Eric joins governance expert Evan Epstein for episode 204 of the Boardroom Governance podcast. Announcing it, Eric says his biggest fear in writing the book was how genuine governance experts would receive it, Epstein being one of those he hoped would like it — “I’ve learned a lot from him about governance over the years, and always follow his podcast and newsletter closely.” He leaves the verdict to the listener: “Was he impressed or were my fears realized? You’ll have to listen and judge for yourself…”
blockquote: One of my biggest fears when writing this book was imagining how genuine governance experts would react to it. After all, I am not a lawyer (although sometimes it feels like I play one on TV).
